# Regression tests the "Integration tests (network)" job must run AND pass.
# Same format and checks as unit.txt.
#
# This list exists because that job reported GREEN having executed ONE test.
# HttpClientFixture's [OneTimeSetUp] calls Assert.Inconclusive when
# httpbin1.servarr.com is unreachable, which self-skips all 54 and leaves the
# leg passing -- and those 54 are the job's entire reason for existing. The
# workflow comment says what that costs: they "had never executed in CI, which
# is how one of them sat three weeks past a hard-coded cookie expiry without
# anyone noticing."
#
# A (passed + failed) > 0 guard does NOT catch it: on the run that exposed
# this, one unrelated Mono test passed, which satisfies it.
#
# Named without its type argument even though NUnit reports the cases as
# HttpClientFixture<ManagedHttpDispatcher>.*, because that is the form
# check_required_tests_wired.py can resolve against the source. assert_tests_ran
# matches the generic form.
#
# 54 is what this job discovers and passes on ubuntu (the only place it runs).
# It fails if the cases are skipped (host unreachable -> not "Passed") or if
# they stop being discovered at all (found < 54). The macOS-only
# [Platform(Exclude = "MacOsX")] on should_execute_get_using_brotli makes a
# local run 53/54, which is why this is a CI-only assertion.
NzbDrone.Common.Test.Http.HttpClientFixture >=54
